verdict.rationale: Bitbucket's own Pipelines lets users create automated CI/CD workflows that run on hosted or private runners. The product page also describes triggering AI-powered workflows from the pipeline to handle tasks like cleaning up feature flags, updating docs, drafting release notes and fixing flaky tests, which together cover autonomous background automation for an AI-native user. Missing for 10: detailed docs on triggers, schedules and how the AI workflows are configured, plus independent or hands-on confirmation that these AI pipeline automations run unattended as claimed.
